content.value: Host A and B are each connected to a switch S via 10 Mbps link as shown in following (10) [CO1] figure.

The propagation delay on each link is 20μs. Assume signaling message for circuit setup and acceptance are 100 bit long and processing time of a signaling message at switch S, hosts A and B is 15μs. These signaling messages are transmitted over the 10 Mbps link. Calculate the total time required to transmit a 10,000-bit message from A to B for circuit switching.
